# pyfixwidth

> Lightweight documentation index for LLMs, MCP tools, and coding agents.

Canonical documentation sources:

- Repository: https://github.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth
- Published docs home: https://poliquin.github.io/pyfixwidth/
- README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/README.md
- Docs home source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/docs/index.md
- Layout format source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/docs/layout-format.md
- Python API source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/docs/python-api.md
- CLI source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/docs/cli.md
- Cookbook source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/docs/cookbook.md
- Agent notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/poliquin/pyfixwidth/master/AGENTS.md

Important constraints:

- `DictReader` requires a binary file object opened for reading.
- `parse_file()` defaults to `encoding='ascii'`.
- `parse_lines()` defaults to `encoding='utf-8'`.
- Blank field content becomes `None` before type conversion.
- Negative widths skip input bytes and do not appear in parsed rows.
- Use `type_errors='ignore'` to continue parsing and replace invalid values with `None`.
